history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration strengthen monitoring to ensure that all the general temporary assistance positions are used in full compliance with related polices and regulations.
history.administration_response: The recommendation was implemented. The revised administrative instruction on administration of appointments (ST/AI/2025/3), which covers all types of appointments, was promulgated on 28 October 2025. In addition, the budget guides for 2026 and 2027 both made reference to and provided guidance on the use and conversion of general temporary assistance positions, including that they should be used to meet surge and short-term requirements. The budget guides further indicate that requests for new positions to address temporary requirements for a period of one year or more are expected, to the extent possible, to be reflected as temporary posts rather than general temporary assistance positions.
history.board_assessment: Given that the administrative instruction on administration of appointments (ST/AI/2025/3) was promulgated on 28 October 2025, and that the budget guides for 2026 and 2027 both made reference to and provided guidance on the use and conversion of general temporary assistance positions, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
